notes: Car I - regional adaptation and channel equality (owner item #16): one explicit local setting decides what the product shows, and it is never detected - no geo lookup, no locale sniffing, no egress (owner ruling). The console gains a Region card (Settings -> General) and the setup wizard gains ONE interactive question (ENTER keeps global; --check/--yes never prompt), both writing settings region.code with the usual read-back discipline. Under region cn: the Exchange/Web3 panel is hidden entirely (nav item and view; deep links, journey buttons and orchestrator jumps walk off to Overview; the personal exNav preference is outranked), the Telegram/Discord/Slack/WhatsApp/Signal channel rows are dimmed with one honest note (they may need a network route you provide yourself - the product claims no per-route certainty) while the domestic five stay untouched, the Bot & Service card carries the same note, and activation drops the two Telegram slots out of the required set so a Feishu/DingTalk-only install reaches READY (global stays byte-identical; REQUIRED_SLOTS itself is untouched). Channel equality shipped in the same car: the Channels card gained a Telegram row with the same treatment as the nine adapter rows (presence words only, never a value), the activation welcome, the three cron hints and the marketing site copy now present channels as equal choices instead of Telegram as the default bot (factual channel-specific mechanisms stay verbatim). New gates: tmp/e2e_car_i.py 28/28 (grammar pairs, non-vacuous activation tiers both ways, wizard mirror) and tmp/e2e_car_i_ui.js 20/20 (the full tier lifecycle on an isolated console). Kickoff also expired-proofed the release-notice pin (0.5.71 -> 0.5.72). Gates: core 2189/2189, smoke 517/517, router 37/37, wizard 106/106, packs 1455, E2E suites 27, capability docs 37, publish READY(0).
